About this Role:

The Senior Construction Auditor is responsible for performing detailed reviews and analyses of construction applications for payment and professional service invoices on assigned projects and programs. This role focuses on verifying that billed costs are accurate, properly supported, and compliant with contract requirements, applicable policies, and established invoice review and exception-handling procedures.

The Senior Construction Auditor/Compliance Analyst works in a dynamic, multi-vendor environment and supports projects delivered under various construction project delivery approaches. This position requires a solid understanding of construction contracts and invoice processing, along with the ability to identify, document, and communicate compliance issues effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established invoice review procedures, instructions, and exception-handling processes.
  • Read, interpret, and understand construction contract provisions related to invoice processing and payment, translating contract requirements into actionable compliance testing.
  • Demonstrate a working understanding of various contract structures and associated cost controls.
  • Verify that each invoice has all required contractual authorizations prior to approval.
  • Understand the scope of work associated with the construction project being billed and assess whether invoiced costs align with approved scope.
  • Review invoices across multiple vendors and contracts, effectively managing complex and high-volume review environments.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with clients and vendors to facilitate communication and timely resolution of issues identified during the invoice review process.
  • Identify non-compliance issues and clearly document findings and associated cost impacts in a concise and accurate manner.
  • Describe identified issues and request appropriate corrective actions in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintain complete and well-organized electronic and paper work papers documenting review procedures, findings, reviewed amounts, and payment recommendations.
  • Create, manipulate, and analyze spreadsheets to support invoice reviews, reconciliations, and tracking.
  • Maintain accurate and timely invoice tracking logs to support payment workflows and reporting.
  • Work independently while exercising sound professional judgment, and seek appropriate guidance and clarification when needed.
  • Collaborate effectively with other members of the audit and project team to ensure consistent application of review procedures.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience reviewing and/or processing construction invoices or payment applications.
  • Construction contract compliance experience.
  • Previous knowledge of the construction industry.
  • Experience with all construction project delivery methods.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and inconsistencies.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate complex cost and contract information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document and explain findings.
  • Strong professional customer service skills and ability to work effectively with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

What’s In It For You:

  • Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal, and supplemental health plans
  • 401(k) with day-one eligibility. You’ll get a 100% match on the first 3% of your eligible compensation and 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5% of your pay.

  • Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development

About Scale Media

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

This is a hands-on leadership role.   • AI-enabled workflows. Using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, creative tagging, and optimization.
  • Agencies and vendors. Managing agency or vendor support where relevant.

  • Scaled Meta and paid social spend across brands
  • A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks
  • Clean, consistent account structures that are easier to scale and diagnose
  • Reliable platform data, with no pixel/CAPI event or audience gaps
  • A media buying team that makes stronger decisions on its own
  • Faster testing velocity, with a clear backlog and documented learnings
  • A higher hit rate on new landing pages, creative, and copy

What We're Looking For

  • Deep Meta and paid social expertise. You've personally managed 8-figure Meta spend for consumer brands, know the platform inside out, and have a playbook on how to scale without losing efficiency that adapts as the platform evolves.
  • Drive to be in the numbers every day. You look at performance daily because you want to, you notice when something moves, and you don't rest until you understand and address it.
  • People leadership. You've managed media buyers and made them measurably better through direct feedback, account reviews, and clear standards.
  • Tracking fluency. You understand pixels, Conversions API, event parameters, and audience exclusions well enough to spot problems and specify fixes.
  • Cross-channel budget experience. You've allocated budget across more than one paid channel and can make tradeoffs between them.
  • Conversion and creative judgment. You can look at a landing page, ad, or piece of copy and say specifically what will improve performance.
  • Testing discipline. You design clean tests, read results honestly, and know when a learning is real.
  • Analytical strength. You're comfortable working through performance data, attribution gaps, and the limits of platform-reported numbers.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.
  • Cross-functional partnership. You work well with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics without adding unnecessary process.
  • 7–10 years of relevant experience, including managing media buyers.

Strong candidate backgrounds include:

Preferred, but Not Required

  • Hands-on Google Search, YouTube, and Performance Max experience

  • Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios
